name: Quote Lockup Reel
summary: One click turns a podcast Draft into a 9:16 quote reel: the strongest 12-22 second quote cut by clause, each shot in a rounded card on black, packed typographic captions that appear word by word beside the speaker, the key line on black, stock B-roll and an original piano bed.

compatibility.selects: Needs Panel runScript/runShell/askAI and Draft motion graphics (generated media authoring). Speaker masks need Selects 2.0.512 or later and use Selects credits; without them words never pass behind the speaker. B-roll needs a Selects build with stock footage search; without it the speaker stays on screen. Tested on macOS arm64; the Windows path has not been run on a Windows PC yet.

de.name: Zitat-Reel mit Typo-Lockups
de.summary: Macht aus einem Podcast-Draft mit einem Klick ein 9:16-Zitat-Reel: das stärkste Zitat von 12–22 Sekunden, nach Satzteilen geschnitten, jede Einstellung in einer abgerundeten Karte auf Schwarz, dichte typografische Untertitel, die Wort für Wort neben der Person erscheinen, die Kernaussage auf Schwarz, Stock-B-Roll und eigene Klaviermusik.

en.name: Quote Lockup Reel
en.summary: One click turns a podcast Draft into a 9:16 quote reel: the strongest 12-22 second quote cut by clause, each shot in a rounded card on black, packed typographic captions that appear word by word beside the speaker, the key line on black, stock B-roll and an original piano bed.

es.name: Reel de citas tipográfico
es.summary: Convierte un Draft de pódcast en un reel de cita 9:16 con un clic: la mejor cita de 12-22 segundos cortada por frases, cada plano en una tarjeta redondeada sobre negro, subtítulos tipográficos compactos que aparecen palabra a palabra junto a quien habla, la frase clave sobre negro, B-roll de stock y un piano original.

fr.name: Reel de citation typographique
fr.summary: Transforme en un clic un Draft de podcast en reel de citation 9:16 : la meilleure citation de 12 à 22 secondes coupée par propositions, chaque plan dans une carte arrondie sur fond noir, des sous-titres typographiques serrés qui apparaissent mot à mot près de l’orateur, la phrase clé sur noir, du B-roll de stock et un piano original.

it.name: Reel di citazioni tipografico
it.summary: Trasforma con un clic un Draft di podcast in un reel di citazione 9:16: la citazione migliore di 12-22 secondi tagliata per frasi, ogni inquadratura in una scheda arrotondata su nero, sottotitoli tipografici compatti che compaiono parola per parola accanto a chi parla, la frase chiave su nero, B-roll di stock e un pianoforte originale.

ja.name: 名言タイポグラフィ・リール
ja.summary: ポッドキャストのDraftをワンクリックで9:16の名言リールに。12〜22秒の名言を節ごとにカットし、各ショットを黒地の角丸カードに収め、話者の横に一語ずつ現れる密なタイポグラフィ字幕、黒画面のキーフレーズ、ストックBロール、オリジナルのピアノ曲を付けます。

ko.name: 명언 타이포 릴
ko.summary: 팟캐스트 Draft를 클릭 한 번으로 9:16 명언 릴로 만듭니다. 12~22초 인용을 절마다 자르고, 각 샷을 검은 바탕의 둥근 카드에 담아 화자 옆에 단어별로 나타나는 촘촘한 타이포 자막, 검은 화면의 핵심 문장, 스톡 B롤, 오리지널 피아노 음악을 넣습니다.

pt.name: Reel de citações tipográfico
pt.summary: Transforma com um clique um Draft de podcast num reel de citação 9:16: a melhor citação de 12 a 22 segundos cortada por frases, cada plano num cartão arredondado sobre preto, legendas tipográficas compactas que surgem palavra a palavra ao lado de quem fala, a frase-chave sobre preto, B-roll de stock e um piano original.

tr.name: Tipografik Alıntı Reel'i
tr.summary: Bir podcast Draft'ını tek tıkla 9:16 alıntı reel'ine dönüştürür: 12-22 saniyelik en güçlü alıntı cümleciklere göre kesilir, her çekim siyah üzerinde yuvarlak köşeli bir kartta durur, konuşanın yanında kelime kelime beliren sık tipografik altyazılar, siyah ekranda ana cümle, stok B-roll ve özgün bir piyano müziği eklenir.

zh.name: 金句排版短片
zh.summary: 一键把播客 Draft 变成 9:16 金句短片：选出 12–22 秒最有力的金句并按分句剪切，每个镜头放进黑底圆角卡片，紧凑的排版字幕在说话人旁逐词出现，关键句放在黑屏上，并配上素材库 B-roll 和原创钢琴配乐。
